annotations.text:
The original layout and copy, with two changes:
• A new typeface — use the Typeface tweak above the desktop artboard to switch between Newsreader, Libre Franklin and IBM Plex.
• No highlighted words. Yellow now appears only in graphics: the logo mark, the hero diagram's claim node, and the context-distorting sparkline.
The mobile artboard shows the default typeface.
Directions explored after v1 — not chosen. Kept for reference.
